abilities.desc_en: Each time Ultra Magnus completes a Light Melee Combo, his Resistance against Physical Attacks goes up by {{var_3}} (Max: 10 Stacks). One stack of Energy Resistance is lost.

abilities.desc_zh: 每次通天晓完成中型近战连击时，他对能量攻击的抵抗力就会增加 {{var_4}}（最多：10 层）。失去一层物理抗性。
abilities.desc_en: Each time Ultra Magnus completes a Medium Melee Combo, his Resistance against Energy Attacks goes up by {{var_4}} (Max: 10 Stacks). One stack of Physical Resistance is lost.

abilities.desc_en: Ranged Attacks: {{var_5}} chance to Nullify an Attack or Melee Buff.

abilities.desc_zh: 重击：{{var_6}} 几率造成燃烧，对 {{var_7}} 攻击造成热伤害，超过 <s>6</s> {{var_8}}。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks: {{var_6}} chance to inflict Burn, dealing Heat damage for {{var_7}} Attack over <s>6</s> {{var_8}}.

abilities.title_en: Special Attacks: Ultra Magnus crushes opponents with his hammer, converting Armor Buffs into Armor Breaks, each applying {{var_9}} Armor reduction for {{var_10}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 特殊技：通天晓用他的锤子粉碎对手，将装甲增益转化为装甲破坏，每次都会对 {{var_10}} 施加 {{var_9}} 装甲减少。
abilities.desc_en: Special Attacks: Ultra Magnus crushes opponents with his hammer, converting Armor Buffs into Armor Breaks, each applying {{var_9}} Armor reduction for {{var_10}}.

abilities.desc_zh:
通天晓为每位活着的队友和每位对手倒下的队友增加攻击力，并为每位倒下的队友和每位对手活着的队友增加物理抗性。

被动：如果活着的队友多于死亡的队友或通天晓独自一人，他会获得+{{var_11}}物理抗性。如果死亡的队友多于活着的或平局的队友，通天晓将获得 {{var_12}} 攻击评级。如果所有队友都死了，他就会获得这两种效果。

+每级大约 {{var_13}}

攻击增益仅影响指挥官的马格努斯，而不影响野外的 AI。
abilities.desc_en:
All for One
Ultra Magnus gains Attack for each alive teammate and each of the opponents' fallen teammates, plus Physical Resistance for each fallen teammate and each of the opponents' alive teammates.
Passive: If more teammates are alive than dead or Ultra Magnus is alone, he gains +{{var_11}} Physical Resistance. If more teammates are dead than alive or tied, Ultra Magnus gains {{var_12}} Attack Rating. If all teammates are dead he gains both effects.
+about {{var_13}} per level
Attack buff only affects Commanders' Magnus's and not AI ones in the wild.

abilities.desc_zh: 当锤子敲响时，审判已经做出。
abilities.desc_en: Gavel Crush - When the hammer strikes, judgment has been made.
